text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- DNA testing being used to identify people from bus crash in Malaysia.
- Unsolved Mafia-style murder of activist sparks furore over law and order in Taiwan.
- Japan trade official expects few solutions during next week's World Trade Organisation conference.
- China and Britain reach agreement on some issues relating to return of Hongkong to Chinese sovereignty next July.
- Chief U.S. trade negotiator Charlene Barshefsky to revive telecom liberalisation talks on sidelines of inaugural World Trade Organisation Ministerial Conference.
- Singapore Airlines confirms having talks to buy stake in Sempati Air.
- Merger of two Central Provident Fund investment schemes will free enough cash to double or triple potential market for life insurance using CPF funds.
- Sngapore International Monetary Exchange announces it will launch futures and options contracts on Taiwanese equities next month.
- CDL Hotels International may spin off hotels worth more than Hong Kong $10 billion into new company to be listed in Hong Kong.
- Keppel Bank raises some Singapore $207 million from placement of 52 million $1 shares at $3.98 each.
- Listed paint maker Berger International aims for 15 percent return on equity per year and hopes to double turnover within three years.
- Econ International diversifying into coal mining in Indonesia.
